## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Make operator-requested processing reproducible and reviewable.

**Scope:** Versioned crop/flip/scale/alignment/matte-background removal/palette conversion recipes and before/after preview.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Every transform class is operator-requested and recorded with pinned algorithm/settings and source/staged hashes; originals remain recoverable.
- [x] Show before/after and require operator approval for applied transform classes; no hidden aesthetic repair or generated imagery.
- [x] Raw bytes, staged pixels, preview RGBA and encoded output representation remain distinct; palette conversion reports information loss.
- [x] Identical source/recipe versions produce identical staged hashes; recipe edits invalidate only affected composition approval.

## Verification

Recipe round-trip/provenance, deterministic transformations, loss-report and affected-review invalidation tests.

Evidence packet: docs/evidence/rsf21/VERIFICATION.md
QA Review: docs/evidence/rsf21/QA_REVIEW.md (QA_PASS)
All 395 public tests, 36 private reference tests, and 22 transformation tests passed. Isolated wheel distribution passed (DISTRIBUTION_CHECK_PASS).

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-20 (M4-02; task ID okckipkcfdqspilmisaewm5y)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** Processing supplies candidates; never asserts anatomy/style validity.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence (add at QA handoff)

- Code changes / diff: Documented in docs/evidence/rsf21/implementation-manifest.json
- Test commands / exit statuses / artifact hashes: 22/22 unit tests, 395/395 public regression tests, 36/36 private tests, isolated wheel build and test pass.
- Milestone gates / limitations: Structural, coverage, visual, preview and native states remain separate.
